source.repository: Independent deterministic synthetic SQL/data instance generator; no real customer data
source.prng: 32-bit LCG: x=(1664525*x + 1013904223) mod 2^32, sample=x mod 127 minus 63
source.limitations: Synthetic, family-correlated, not production-representative; SQL grammar deliberately mixes supported and unsupported rules
